reviewFocus.en: Check enrollment, supported alert types and the linked Azure subscription before enabling generation. Validate fixes manually and through tests; generating a suggestion does not itself remediate an alert.
reviewFocus.ko: 참여 승인·지원 경고 유형·연결된 Azure 구독을 확인한 후 수정 생성을 활성화할 것을 제안합니다. 수정은 직접 검토하고 테스트해야 하며 제안 생성만으로 경고가 해결되지는 않습니다.

en.title: Azure DevOps Autofix: preview phases, review gates and billing

claims.text: Microsoft’s launch post describes Copilot Autofix for GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps as a limited private preview with enrollment processed in waves. The launch post and later documentation must not be collapsed into an unchanged availability claim.

evidence.quote: Copilot Autofix is available today in limited private preview for GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps.

claims.text: The launch workflow generates a suggested change from supported CodeQL alerts and opens a pull request. Existing review and build gates still run, and the alert resolves after merge and the next CodeQL scan.

evidence.quote: Your usual review and build gates run on the pull request. Once it merges and the next CodeQL scan completes, the alert resolves on its own.

followUp.text: At review time, the official guide labels the feature a limited public preview and says Microsoft is not accepting additional users. This is a later documented state, not evidence that the original private-preview wording was false.

evidence.quote: This feature is in limited public preview. Microsoft isn't currently accepting additional users for the preview.

followUp.text: The current guide says fix generation consumes AI credits billed through the linked Azure subscription, and GitHub Copilot budgets and user limits do not govern that Azure DevOps meter. License inclusion should not be read as free fix generation.

evidence.quote: Generating a fix consumes AI credits from your organization's Azure billing meter.
GitHub Copilot budget settings and user limits configured on GitHub don't apply to Copilot Autofix meter spend in Azure DevOps.

claims.text: Microsoft의 출시 글은 Azure DevOps용 GitHub Advanced Security의 Copilot Autofix를 순차적으로 참여를 허용하는 제한된 비공개 미리보기로 설명한다. 출시 글과 후속 문서를 변하지 않은 제공 상태로 합쳐 서술하면 안 된다.

evidence.quote: Copilot Autofix is available today in limited private preview for GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps.

claims.text: 출시 글의 작업 흐름은 지원되는 CodeQL 경고에서 수정 제안을 만들고 PR을 연다. 기존 검토·빌드 검사는 계속 실행되며 병합 후 다음 CodeQL 스캔이 완료되어야 경고가 해소된다.

evidence.quote: Your usual review and build gates run on the pull request. Once it merges and the next CodeQL scan completes, the alert resolves on its own.

followUp.text: 검토 시점의 공식 지침은 기능을 제한된 공개 미리보기로 표시하고 추가 사용자를 받지 않는다고 설명한다. 후속 문서의 상태이며 최초 비공개 미리보기 표현이 거짓이었다는 근거는 아니다.

evidence.quote: This feature is in limited public preview. Microsoft isn't currently accepting additional users for the preview.

followUp.text: 현재 지침은 수정 생성이 연결된 Azure 구독에서 과금되는 AI 크레딧을 사용하고, GitHub Copilot 예산·사용자 제한이 해당 Azure DevOps 과금에 적용되지 않는다고 설명한다. 라이선스에 포함된다는 설명을 무료 수정 생성으로 해석하면 안 된다.

evidence.quote: Generating a fix consumes AI credits from your organization's Azure billing meter.
GitHub Copilot budget settings and user limits configured on GitHub don't apply to Copilot Autofix meter spend in Azure DevOps.
